long_biography.plain_text:
In 2012, Dirk van der Plas travelled to Australia to examine a fishing venture with Seafish Tasmania on behalf of Parlevliet & Van der Plas. Discussions with senior fisheries regulators were central to the visit. The partners planned to process catches at sea for sale as food in international markets.

In Europe, van der Plas saw the acquisition of Nordpesca alongside the Platvis Holland partnership as a way to reach more of the fresh-fish market. The Belgian business was to move to Middelburg, retaining Daniel Lokker from its existing management to run the operation.
